# MazeTilings llms.txt
Concise guide for LLMs: Maze-to-Wang-tiling utilities (renderer-agnostic) targeting `netstandard2.1`. SVG demos live elsewhere; focus on the library code below.

## Dependencies (critical)
- `CrawfisSoftware.Maze`
- `CrawfisSoftware.Tiling`

## Documentation
- [MazeTilings README](https://github.com/crawfis/TilingFramework/blob/master/MazeTilings/README.md) — library overview, usage, and scope.
- Dependency docs:
  - [CrawfisSoftware.Maze repo](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Maze) | [README](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Maze/blob/main/README.md)
  - [CrawfisSoftware.Tiling repo](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling) | [README](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/README.md) | [llms.txt](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/llms.txt)

## Key source files
- [MazeWrapperTilingBuilder.cs](https://github.com/crawfis/TilingFramework/blob/master/MazeTilings/MazeWrapperTilingBuilder.cs) — maps `Maze<int,int>` cells to tiles via enumerators/selectors.
- [WangColorizer.cs](https://github.com/crawfis/TilingFramework/blob/master/MazeTilings/WangColorizer.cs) — dynamic Wang tile-set creation from a colorizer.
- [MazeColorizers.cs](https://github.com/crawfis/TilingFramework/blob/master/MazeTilings/MazeColorizers.cs) — direction-based color mapping helpers.
- [AbstractMazeColorizer.cs](https://github.com/crawfis/TilingFramework/blob/master/MazeTilings/AbstractMazeColorizer.cs) — base for metric-aware colorizers.
- [IMazeTileSelector.cs](https://github.com/crawfis/TilingFramework/blob/master/MazeTilings/IMazeTileSelector.cs) — interface for maze-aware tile selection.
- [PathTileSetFactory.cs](https://github.com/crawfis/TilingFramework/blob/master/MazeTilings/PathTileSetFactory.cs) — builds arc/Manhattan path tile sets.
- [TileSizePathTileDecorator.cs](https://github.com/crawfis/TilingFramework/blob/master/MazeTilings/TileSizePathTileDecorator.cs) — resizes path tiles.
- [PathTile.cs](https://github.com/crawfis/TilingFramework/blob/master/MazeTilings/PathTile.cs) — concrete path tile implementation.
- [UnityStubs.cs](https://github.com/crawfis/TilingFramework/blob/master/MazeTilings/UnityStubs.cs) — Unity-compatible stubs for `Vector3`, etc.

## Scope notes
- Renderer-agnostic: consume `ITiling2D` with your own renderer; SVG lives in `ExampleProjects/MazeTilingSVG`.
- Keep focus on interfaces and builders above for API understanding.
